bio: A former pub has been transformed into a relaxed, urban restaurant serving entirely vegetarian cuisine in the form of a menu that is designed for sharing. In the evening, the Kleines Menü comprises 12 dishes in five courses and a Grosses Menü made up of 15 dishes organised into seven courses – ideal for sharing! Delicious dishes such as watermelon sashimi with kimchi broth, fermented radish, ponzu gel and black garlic mayonnaise mean that even non-vegetarians won't miss meat or fish. At lunchtime, choose between a simple, quick lunch, a slightly more sophisticated Business-Lunch and the small evening menu.
